new_value: Already implemented - duty cycle APIs correctly support all regulatory limits (permille 1-1000 for US/CA 100%, EU 1%, AU/NZ 5%). 32-entry circular buffer with head/len tracking implemented in hal_duty.c. Permille validation in lichen_duty_cycle_init() clamps invalid values to default 10 (EU). Tests in test_duty_cycle_ccp13 and test_duty_cycle_tracker_matches_ccp13_vectors validate core functionality.
